title: Check Discrete Gradient
text: Check that absolute value of difference between successive samples of discrete signal is less than specified value, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Maximum gradient} sets the maximum value of allowed differences, {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the whether to stop simulation when check, {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal and {Select icon type}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal checked against gradient scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Maximum gradient
params.values: Maximum value of allowed differences 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable check on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails "" (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Whether to stop simulation when check fails on (default) | off
